verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents fast integration paths: a Hosted Payment Page billed as a 'fully branded checkout page in less than a day', no-code Payment Links, low-code Flow, plugins, and a self-serve test account signup. However, onboarding is sales-led ('get in touch with our team today to create a plan'), with no self-serve rate card, and positioning targets enterprise and scaling businesses. Nothing shows a founder can go from signup to accepting live card payments within a day. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve live-account activation and merchant approval within a day, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the time-to-first-live-payment.
